finding.claim: test_default_callers compares a list in Terraform's map order, which sorts by key. The skill says 'add the new caller' without saying that the entry goes in key order, so a repo whose name sorts before `loop-engineering-harness` fails the test when appended. The step 3.4 test run catches it, so this costs a retry and nothing more. Say 'in key order'.

fixes.change: Asks which folders to sync (default docs and .okf), drops folders from the template and filters on both; gives the real reason to push before pinning; says to add the caller in key order. Also makes each step-4 block one self-contained shell call.
